descrizione: The project created by the partnership between the University of Milano-Bicocca and the Alma Mater Studiorum-University of Bologna, within the framework of the Projects of Relevant National Interest (PRIN) 2022 financed by the European Union - Next Generation EU, that aims to quantitatively assess the different recharge components to the Po Plain alluvial aquifers in the Piedmont Area, focusing on the recharge from the mountain front

MidAS-Po (Hydrogeological Model of Groundwater in the Po River District) is a large-scale project aimed at improving the understanding and management of groundwater resources across the Po Plain. The project develops the first district-scale conceptual and numerical hydrogeological model of the Po River Basin, integrating geological, hydrogeological and groundwater-level data to characterize aquifer systems, groundwater flows and water balances. The model will support the assessment of groundwater status and availability, water-resource management, and future scenario analysis under climate change and increasing water scarcity.
